scope: Read-only public OpenRouter route and tariff eligibility audit for the MA24 standard main-Agent evaluation profile; no cost ledger or tariff activation

productWire.interpretation: Disabling provider fallback does not select a single provider before routing. The provider preference only requires parameters and denies data collection.

publicPagesChecked.observation: Separate cache-read and cache-write prices are listed; multiple providers are available.
Separate cache and web-search prices are listed; multiple providers are available.

The displayed headline reflects a provider route; the same page lists other providers with different input/output prices. Search indexing showed a different historical headline, so it cannot be treated as a fixed model-wide maximum.

decision: The observed public headline prices are useful route identification evidence, not a verified maximum per-call bound. Keep paid evaluation closed until provider routing and all charge classes are bounded, the exact wire size/output ceilings and durable reservation are implemented, and the user-approved spend scope is frozen.
